Geometry selection: Prepared::regions/curves/holes (compute/execute/prologue.rs) and ItemUse in Capabilities decide which items the op gets. Do not parse polygons yourself.

Param plumbing: #[derive(OpParams)] + impl_operation_params! (operation_configs.rs:2780-2860) already provide the MCP schema, CLI keys, setters and help text. Do not hand-write ParamDef arrays or MCP/CLI handling. The GUI tooltips and ranges come from schema_range / help_for / p() in crates/rs_cam_viz/src/ui/properties/linking_dressup.rs:35-111.

GUI row helpers: dv, dv_pill, depth_caution_row, region_ordering_row (boundary_2d.rs:154), and draw_outline_diagram / draw_stepover_diagram (shape_diagrams.rs) already exist. Pocket/Zigzag copy these.

Capabilities presets: TRANSFORM_DEPTH_ORDER, TRANSFORM_TRACE, AIR_CUT_BAR_CLEARING_PCT, ToolConstraintsDef::ANY_TOOL, DressupPolicy::ANY_DRESSUP, OpPolicy::MILLING (registry.rs:84-128). Do not invent new constants.
Spindle RPM and feed resolution: effective_spindle_rpm (catalog.rs:1448). Do not read post.spindle_speed directly.

is_stock_based / geometry_requirement / is_3d on OperationConfig (catalog.rs:1090-1115) decide model requirements. Callers (crates/rs_cam_viz/src/controller/events/toolpath.rs:153, crates/rs_cam_viz/src/app/mcp/commands.rs:936) already read them.
ambiguity: Which sibling to copy: Pocket (PocketConfig with a pattern enum, finishing_passes, own cutting_levels arm at catalog.rs:1403), Zigzag (simplest Layered kernel, but classify() puts it in the 3D arm), Trace (curve ops with ItemUse override by compensation) or Chamfer (derives Z from the cutter, and sits on the Layered runner via curve_engrave.rs:216-340). Each differs on cutting_levels, ItemUse, hooks and geometry_class, and nothing says which is canonical.

Two generator homes: compute/execute/clearing_2d.rs (area-clearing ops) versus compute/execute/curve_engrave.rs (Chamfer, curve ops). Which file a new 2.5D op joins depends on whether it clears areas or follows curves.

Diagram choice in OP_UI_ROWS: OpDiagram::Stepover (needs a from_operation arm) versus OpDiagram::Draw(dia_x) (viz registry.rs bespoke diagrams) versus OpDiagram::None(reason). Sibling ops use all three.
Where the GUI editor function lives: boundary_2d.rs (Pocket, Zigzag, Profile, Face, Adaptive, VCarve, Inlay) versus engrave.rs (Chamfer, Trace) versus drill.rs. Splits are by name, not rule.

feeds_family choice: reuse FeedsOperationFamily::Pocket (Zigzag, Face do) versus Contour or Trace (Profile, Chamfer). A genuinely new family would force new matches throughout crates/rs_cam_core/src/feeds/ (support.rs, vendor_lut.rs). The enum is not X-macro generated.
Depth stepping: PocketConfig/ProfileConfig build DepthStepping with finishing_passes by hand (catalog.rs:1403-1415), while Zigzag/Trace/Adaptive use the 'uniform' closure (:1397).
Per-op validation: val_stepover_under_diameter (viz registry.rs:420) is a shared wildcard match, while val_drill is a per-op guard. Two patterns for 'add a validation'.
